title: v4.1 install OpenClaw CLI without interactive onboarding
backup: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $d=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'discovery.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; [ordered]@{openclawPresentBefore=[bool]$d.openclawPresent; openclawDirExistsBefore=(Test-Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'))} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'install-before.json') -Encoding UTF8; if(Test-Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw')){Copy-Item (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw') (Join-Path $root 'openclaw-before') -Recurse -Force}; Write-Output 'V41_048_BACKUP=PASS'
script: if(-not(Get-Command openclaw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){ $installer=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://openclaw.ai/install.ps1'; & ([ScriptBlock]::Create($installer.Content)) -NoOnboard }; $cmd=Get-Command openclaw -ErrorAction Stop; $v=& openclaw --version 2>&1; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_INSTALL_VERIFY_FAILED'}; $v | Out-String | Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge/openclaw-version.txt' -Encoding UTF8; Write-Output 'V41_048_INSTALL=PASS'
test: if(-not(Get-Command openclaw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){throw 'OPENCLAW_COMMAND_MISSING'}; $v=& openclaw --version 2>&1; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_VERSION_FAILED'}; Write-Output 'V41_048_TEST=PASS'
rollback: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $b=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'install-before.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; if(-not $b.openclawPresentBefore -and (Get-Command openclaw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){ try{& openclaw uninstall --yes 2>$null | Out-Null}catch{} }; if(Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'openclaw-before')){Remove-Item (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'openclaw-before') (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw') -Recurse -Force}; Write-Output 'V41_048_ROLLBACK=PASS'
